history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

Phase 1’s Type A is 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor, so more of the space is kept for living areas. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft monthly, inclusive of sinking fund; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. I’ll confirm the exact monthly maintenance amount and any other recurring charges. Since you’re hoping to buy, a viewing could help you assess the layout in person. Is this mainly for your own stay or as an investment?

It would be for our own stay. The three-bedroom layout sounds like it could suit us, and I’d be open to viewing it once we understand the price and monthly costs. Could you also check whether a car park is included?

For your own stay, the 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms could give you flexibility as your household needs change, while the open-plan living area keeps the shared space connected. I can’t confirm the car-park inclusion or current total price without checking the specific unit and package; the exact monthly ownership total is still being confirmed too. I’ll verify the current price and car-park allocation so you can assess the costs before deciding about a viewing.
